compact.purpose: Fast, bounded review of obvious developer-experience friction.

full_audit.purpose: Repo-level DX audit with metrics, risks, and prioritized remediation.

implementation.purpose: Scoped code or docs changes after requirements and acceptance criteria are clear.

review_only.purpose: Read-only review for public interfaces, security, docs, or TypeScript risk.

metrics.future_measurement_method: time scripted fresh clone through first successful local run
measure documented setup commands in an isolated environment
time project dev-server command until first ready signal
measure hot reload or smallest validation rerun latency
record focused test command wall-clock time
read CI provider run duration when authenticated metadata is available
count required human-only setup steps in README or setup docs
count commands required for local confidence
detect explicit quickstart or equivalent setup path
detect command that proves setup succeeded
count unsupported, conflicting, or missing instructions with citations
read model-selection and orchestration telemetry when recorded

capabilities.purpose: Find and prioritize developer workflow friction across setup, local commands, validation, docs, and CI.
responsibilities: identify quick wins and larger investments
rank findings by developer impact and implementation risk
evidence_expectations: cite commands, docs, config files, or observed timings
capabilities.assumptions_policy: State assumptions and whether they were measured, inferred, or unavailable.

second_brain_behavior.when_available: Use prior project conventions and known pain points as supporting context.
second_brain_behavior.when_unavailable: Use repo-local docs, configs, and command evidence only.

capabilities.purpose: Review public APIs, SDKs, CLIs, config schemas, examples, errors, and migration paths from a developer-consumer perspective.
responsibilities: identify breaking or confusing interface behavior
evidence_expectations: cite public entrypoints, docs, tests, examples, or errors
capabilities.assumptions_policy: Do not invent consumer expectations; label inferred expectations.

second_brain_behavior.when_available: Use known consumer preferences only as non-blocking context.
second_brain_behavior.when_unavailable: Use repo-local public contracts and examples.

capabilities.purpose: Create or revise developer-first documentation that is accurate, practical, and validation-backed.
evidence_expectations: cite source behavior or commands before documenting it
capabilities.assumptions_policy: Do not document speculative features as shipped.

second_brain_behavior.when_available: Use house style preferences as supporting context.
second_brain_behavior.when_unavailable: Follow repo-local docs and observed behavior.

capabilities.purpose: Perform contextual security review for changes involving permissions, secrets, auth, dependencies, tools, CI, logs, privacy, or network/file-system risk.
evidence_expectations: cite exact files, config keys, commands, or data flows
capabilities.assumptions_policy: Mark unknown threat surfaces instead of declaring them safe.

second_brain_behavior.when_available: Use prior security decisions as context, not as proof.

capabilities.purpose: Handle TypeScript-specific DX issues around strictness, inference, public types, package boundaries, and typecheck/build performance.
responsibilities: review public TypeScript API and inferred types
inspect strict compiler or package boundary issues
evidence_expectations: cite type errors, public type declarations, package config, or build output
capabilities.assumptions_policy: Do not generalize TypeScript advice beyond observed type surfaces.

second_brain_behavior.when_available: Use project TypeScript conventions as supporting context.
second_brain_behavior.when_unavailable: Use tsconfig, package metadata, and local source.

capabilities.purpose: Implement from PRDs, ADRs, design specs, issues, or acceptance criteria while preserving scope and logging assumptions.
responsibilities: record assumptions, verification, and residual risk
evidence_expectations: cite spec lines or acceptance criteria and matching verification
capabilities.assumptions_policy: Stop for destructive, security-sensitive, data-loss, or broad architecture decisions; otherwise log bounded assumptions.

second_brain_behavior.when_available: Use prior decisions only to interpret ambiguous local spec context.
second_brain_behavior.when_unavailable: Use the provided spec and repo-local truth.
